summary: intersection fast path when receiver size is no larger than intrinsic other Set.

semantics.path: iterate receiver data and call other.has for each live value
semantics.receiver_reentrancy: receiver growth during has calls is observable and iteration extends

tests.name: this-side path
tests.input: const a=new Set([1]); const b=new Set([1,2]); console.log([...a.intersection(b)]);
tests.expected_behavior: uses receiver-scan branch with the specified result

tests.name: signed-zero membership
tests.input: const a=new Set([-0]); const b=new Set([+0,2]); console.log([...a.intersection(b)].length);
